name: match_obligation_to_controls
description: Given one obligation and a list of candidate controls, return for each control a match score (0-100) and a reason. Only emit controls that semantically address the obligation. Missing = gap. Call this tool exactly once with the structured list of matches.

reasoning.description: One-sentence justification grounded in the prior analysis, before the score.

meets_jurisdiction_specifics.description: "no" only when the control addresses the same safeguard but fails a jurisdiction-specific parameter named or implied by the obligation; "not_applicable" when the obligation carries no jurisdiction-specific parameter.

missing_specific.description: One short sentence naming the concrete jurisdiction-specific delta, e.g. "policy states five years; the obligation requires ten". Empty when not applicable.
